name: blast-radius
query: Before I refactor app/services/billing.py, what imports it and what would break?
why: Importers/blast-radius is a graph question; the skill's core verb.

name: index-repo
query: Index this codebase so we can query the dependency graph instead of grepping around.
why: Explicit ask to index/query a repo's dependency structure.

name: find-dead-code
query: Find dead code in this repo - modules nothing actually uses anymore.
why: Liveness tiers are the skill's differentiating feature.

name: what-actually-runs
query: We have lcov output from CI. Fold it in and tell me which functions never execute.
why: Coverage ingest joined onto the graph is a first-class command.

name: orient-unfamiliar
query: I just inherited this 4000-file monorepo. Map its entry points and how the services connect.
why: Orientation in a codebase too large to read; entrypoints + index.

name: vault-backlinks
query: What links to the Zone Planning note in my Obsidian vault?
why: Markdown vault traversal belongs to obsidian-kg.

name: docs-tree-query
query: Make our docs folder of markdown runbooks queryable.
why: A markdown corpus is obsidian-kg's domain even outside Obsidian.

name: code-review
query: Review this diff for bugs before I merge it.
why: Correctness review is not structure mapping; other skills own it.

name: runtime-debug
query: Why does this import throw ModuleNotFoundError in production at startup?
why: A live debugging task, not a corpus-indexing one.
